name: securefix
description: A developer-facing secure-code-review portfolio: exploit -> fix -> custom rule -> CI gate, per vuln class.

scripts.sast:docker: docker run --rm -v "%cd%:/src" -w /src semgrep/semgrep semgrep scan --config semgrep-rules --config p/typescript --config p/owasp-top-ten --error
scripts.sast:docker:rules: docker run --rm -v "%cd%:/src" -w /src semgrep/semgrep semgrep scan --config semgrep-rules src
